title: Chapter 324
text:
After the scavenger attack, Short Horn Star did not stop midway and headed straight for Juberly Hub.

A few days later, a floating steel fortress appeared outside the porthole. Juberly Hub's futuristic design, coupled with countless stars in the distance as its background, gave it a creepy yet mysterious aura.

Spaceships docked and departed from the space station, leaving colorful trails of light in space. From afar, there were thousands of colorful trails around the space station. Although it was silent in space, it gave off an inexplicable lively atmosphere, like fireworks blooming in the night sky.

The beauty of civilization was nothing more than that.

Opening the local channel on the communicator, countless local calls appeared. Every spaceship was applying, and the hub was officially dispatched. Different languages, voices, and mechanical sounds mixed together to form a unique symphony.

The bustling atmosphere was completely different from the silent appearance.

Short Horn Star slowed down and slowly approached Juberly Hub.

As they got closer, the space station gradually enlarged in the porthole and soon occupied all the space. It was then that they realized how huge this space fortress was. Short Horn Star, which was the size of a small city, was like a soybean compared to a watermelon when compared to Juberly Hub.

The players who were seeing it for the first time had looks of shock and amazement on their faces. The incomparable shock struck deep into their hearts. In front of this space station, everyone deeply felt the feeling of insignificance.

"So … so big!"

"It's like a planet."

"So, this is the sea of stars."

Excitement quietly rose in his heart, and soon after, his face was filled with infatuation.

The sea of stars was the deep curiosity of every race that looked up at the stars, and the players were no exception. Pork Bun recorded everything and could not stop at all. He wished he could open a few more shots.

Han Xiao was used to this, so he was very calm. He stroked his chin and pondered.

Entering Juberly Hub was the first step to officially embarking on a galactic journey. Juberly Hub was a transit station and also a huge communication center. Many organizations had offices there, and it was also the gathering and distribution center of the Colton Star Cluster. It could even be considered a transportation center. It had a lot of functions, and it even had long-term rentals for people to stay in.

In Han Xiao's plan, Juberly Hub was an important place for the first phase of the operation. Many operations had to be extended from Juberly Hub. If his operation plan in the Colton Star Cluster was like a spider web, Juberly Hub would be the center of the web.

Han Xiao felt that the most important goal now was to make a breakthrough in his strength and ensure his safety. Level 70 was not enough in the galaxy, and he had an astronomical amount of experience of 2.7 billion. Now that he had a foundation, he had to find a way to convert it into combat power. Therefore, he had to deal with the Class change requirements, which were the two factors of subclass and class advancement knowledge..

In Juberly Hub, he could buy class advancement knowledge on the exchange, and the Enas he had saved up could be put to good use. Han Xiao now had two class advancement knowledges, and the Class change requirement was five. Although he did not know the current market price of class advancement knowledge, according to Han Xiao's memory, he did not have enough money to spend with his 13,000. Knowledge had always been expensive.

However, compared to Blue Star, the process of obtaining class advancement knowledge was dozens of times simpler. As long as he had money, there was no need to spend so much effort to form relationships.

Earning money was an important goal, so he had to start from scratch.

This time, the broadcast sounded, and the captain's magnetic voice came out.

"We are about to enter Spaceport 273. All passengers, please head to the bridge area to wait for landing. Thank you for choosing the Short Horn Star Travel Group. Once again, we apologize for the accident of this trip. Thank you for riding with us."

Short Horn Star entered the large spaceport, and the bottom of the spaceship was embedded in the track. After stabilizing, the metal door of the spaceport opened, and the spaceship entered along the track. The spaceport closed, isolating the outside space. Entering a gravitational environment from a zero-gravity environment, Short Horn Star suddenly sank. There was a stable gravitational cycle inside the spaceship, but the passengers did not feel anything.

The passengers on the spaceship headed to the bridge area behind the cabin door to wait to disembark and collect their luggage. The players were carrying Han Xiao's supply boxes, which attracted a lot of attention. The surrounding passengers knew that Han Xiao had protected the spaceship, so they all looked at him with kind eyes … Well, that was only if they could distinguish the eye structure of different races. Only then would they know that a murderous look was a sign of kindness in some races. Anyway, the players felt uncomfortable all over, as if they would be pounced on at any time.

"I'm free!" Kerlodd opened his arms excitedly as if he was hugging the sky.

"Don't be so excited, Andy Dufresne. You've been treated well. I didn't mistreat you." Han Xiao glanced at him. "You even earned 1,500 Enas because of me. I think you should thank me."

"If you return my equipment to me, I will indeed thank you."

"Wow, it's so noisy here. What did you just say?"

Kerlodd shook his head helplessly. It would be impossible to make Han Xiao spit out what he had taken. He became serious.

"I need to go back and report my work and write a progress report. I will keep my promise and not pursue you. Even if you doubt my integrity, according to the danger level of the investigator profession, your actions are not enough to make you a wanted criminal. So, you can rest assured that no one will trouble you."

"Sounds good." Han Xiao put down his gun with a smile.

"It's my bad luck to have met you," Kerlodd said unhappily.

Han Xiao smiled and was in a good mood. "I'm very happy."

The spaceship shook and stopped. The hatch slowly opened, and a white platform appeared outside. It was as big as a square, and the lights were bright. The dome was hundreds of meters high, and it was magnificent. Only a port of such size could fit Short Horn Star. At the end of the platform was the entrance to the space station.

Han Xiao led the players and followed the crowd down the spaceship. He saw Lerden from the corner of his eyes. This guy was in a hurry, not willing to waste even a second. He quickly walked to the entrance with the bounty criminals and was at the very front.

After the attack, Han Xiao and Lerden did not talk a second time. Their relationship stopped at meeting, but it was not a big deal.

If I interfere with the Sunil storyline, we should have a chance to meet again.

After walking through the long and winding tunnel, they finally arrived at the interior of Juberly Hub. In front of them was a huge space. The official name was' Hub Hall ', but even though it was called a hall, it was as big as a city, dozens of square kilometers wide.

At the end of the Hub Hall was a huge curved window that looked out at the space outside. Han Xiao and the others came in from the entrance near the window.

The dome of the Hub Hall was extremely high. The top was almost a thousand meters away from the ground. In the center was a white tower that connected the dome. With this tower as the center, the surrounding buildings that were hundreds of meters high rose from the ground and extended out in a circle. The shapes of the buildings were different. Every building took up a large area, and every floor was a platform with all kinds of facilities and venues. Bridges were connected between the buildings for pedestrians to pass through. Countless bridges in the air were high and low, and they were complicated like a maze. Many small public aircrafts were shuttling between the bridges.

The ground was also filled with small and large facilities, such as stadiums, theaters, open-air venues, and so on. Different races talked to each other, and the aircrafts flew by in the sky. It was very lively. The players felt like they did not have enough eyes. This feeling was like flowers in the sky, cows and sheep could be seen in the wind, and apes were crying on both sides of the river. A group of white herons flew into the sky.

In short, they were so excited that they could not speak properly.

The Hub Hall has many functions, and it can be divided into more than a dozen areas. There are restaurants with all kinds of civilizations that serve all kinds of weird food, shops that sell clothes and equipment, and places for leisure and entertainment, such as theaters, bars, racing activities, sports, and gambling. There are also places for Supers to train, gravity rooms, combat simulations, meditation rooms, machine modification workshops, offices that provide part-time jobs, such as authoritative organizations like the Universe Mercenary Alliance and the Magician's Society. There are also financial groups and organizations that hire people, online exchanges in the Star Cluster area, shipyards that repair and build spaceships, and so on … Han Xiao's memory flashed past.

Basically, this place could satisfy all his needs temporarily.
